correctness.rationale: PASS: Enumerated both E8 root families and antipodal identifications, yielding 120 lines and an exact (120,63,30,36) orthogonality graph; adjacency spectrum 63^1,3^84,(-9)^35 follows from A^2=27I-6A+36J. The even Gegenbauer kernel is (u-w)I+(v-w)A+wJ, giving eigenvalues u+63v+56w, u+3v-4w and u-9v+8w. Independently computed degree 0..16 triples by exact rational recurrence; ell=8 yields (3240,1260,1296), ell=10 (0,3060,2952). For all ell>=12, the displayed polynomial strict Gershgorin bound has constant 1904 and strictly positive coefficients in s=ell-12, proving full rank beyond finite checks. Addition theorem gives evaluation Gram up to positive factor; cond^2=3240/1260=18/7. Finite exact graph enumeration checked 3780 orthogonal and 3360 nonorthogonal pairs, with common-neighbor counts 30/36.

value.rationale: PASS: The 120 E8 projective root lines are a canonical exceptional design; knowing the least individual even degree achieving interpolation, the full all-even-degree rank spectrum and sharp conditioning is a natural harmonic-sampling invariant. Full rank at 8, loss of a one-dimensional constant sector at 10, and permanent recovery beyond 12 are a meaningful nonmonotone cutoff, not a dimensionality-only observation.

limitations: Even-degree spherical-harmonic restriction to 120 unoriented root lines only.
